findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed support [0.0,0.49]: it rises from near zero to a positive peak around t≈0.11, then falls to a negative trough around t≈0.19, and returns toward zero by the end of the window.
The endpoint contrast is small relative to the interior excursion: whole-window z is -0.18 and the first/last node z values are 0.14 and 0.18, while the interior swing spans roughly -1.4 to +0.85 z.

The observed-node linear fit is not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE≈0.78) and the curve shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, so a single monotone trend is not supported.

The score clock is defined on observed score nodes 0.0 to 0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5] and equal score prior (recorded affinities removed); this is the support over which any temporal contrast must be matched.

hypotheses.direction: non-monotone: early positive, mid-window negative, returning toward zero at the endpoint
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign reversal, or a batch-stable monotone profile, would falsify the non-monotone contrast.
hypotheses.statement: A time-dependent contrast in landmark_00_local_dx exists on the observed support, with a positive excursion early (t≈0.05-0.13) and a negative excursion mid-window (t≈0.15-0.25), rather than a stationary target.

hypotheses.direction: endpoint magnitude smaller than interior magnitude
hypotheses.falsifier: An endpoint z comparable in magnitude to the interior excursion would falsify this claim.
hypotheses.statement: Because the endpoint contrast is near zero while the interior excursion is large, an endpoint-only reward on this coordinate would not distinguish the observed trajectory shape from a stationary target.

limitations: Only one coordinate proxy (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; other landmark coordinates and soft_mass features were not inspected.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves are accessible.
The curve is a coordinate proxy in predicted endpoint world-A features; no energy, chemical-interaction, or neural-module interpretation is supported.
Selection preference is association only; no descendant survival or measured final benefit is available in this input.
The observed-node linear fit was not accepted and the curve has many sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so no single monotone trend or absolute target is established.
